name: typed-json
tldr: Typed JSON and text columns with no validator dependency.
description: Gives JSON and text columns a TypeScript type without pulling in a schema library. The prisma-json-types-generator idea, rebuilt as a Prisma 8 extension.

name: zod-json
tldr: Typed JSON columns described and enforced by a zod schema.
description: Declare a JSON column from a zod schema. The column's TypeScript type follows the schema and values are validated against it at runtime. Implements the `zod/json@1` codec.

name: IndexedDB
tldr: Prisma 8 for IndexedDB: a browser database from your PSL schema, with typed accessors and explicit migrations.
description: Adds IndexedDB as a Prisma 8 database family for browser code. Write a `.prisma` schema, emit the contract, and `createAutoMigratingIdbClient` opens the database and applies pending migrations before it resolves. Ships typed `db.orm` model accessors, transactions, an optional bidirectional sync extension, and `@idb.exclude` attributes that keep server-only fields out of the client contract.

name: citext
tldr: Case-insensitive text columns backed by PostgreSQL citext, with the CREATE EXTENSION migration included.
description: Adds a `citext.Citext()` column type for PSL and a `citext()` helper for the TypeScript builder. Values are plain strings that read back exactly as written, while equality, `in`, `like`, `@unique`, foreign keys, ordering, `include` and `distinctOn` all ignore case. Ships a migration that runs `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext` before your tables, so there is no manual setup. Built against 8.0.0-rc.14. `citext[]` arrays are not supported yet.
